prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a rear-end collision in Houston, Texas, and has knee injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1227; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement is about the rear-end collision you were involved in here in Houston. Do you understand that this call is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Please tell me in your own words what happened.

A: I was stopped at a red light on a main road, waiting to turn. The car behind me didn't stop in time and hit my rear bumper pretty hard.

Q: How fast do you think the other vehicle was going when it hit you?

A: I'd guess it was moving at a decent clip, maybe twenty or twenty-five miles an hour. I heard the brakes squeal just before the impact.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?

A: Yes, I was.

Q: Did you feel any pain or discomfort right after the collision?

A: My knee hit the dashboard. It hurt right away, and by the time I got out of the car it was swollen and I could barely put weight on it.

Q: Have you seen a doctor or received any treatment for your knee?

A: Yes. I went to an urgent care clinic that same day, and they took X-rays. I've since been referred to an orthopedic specialist for an MRI and physical therapy.

Q: Do you still have pain or limited movement in the knee?

A: Yes. Stairs are difficult, and I've had to stop working some shifts because I can't stand for long periods.

Q: Is there anything else you think I should know about the accident or your injuries?

A: Not that I can think of right now. I just want to get my knee taken care of and get back to normal.

Q: Thank you. That concludes the statement.

A: Thank you.
